plain.li: [plank:voice] The newest of us should count as much as the oldest, and with me they will.
[plank:ready] When the next raid comes I want everyone knowing where to stand, you too.
[plank:home] Vote for me and I'll bring everyone home from every fight, or come home last.
[plank:fairshare] A fair share for everyone and favourites for nobody, that's how I'd keep the stores.
[plank:silver] Every trader who comes will leave a little poorer and us a little richer.
[plank:clean] The sick deserve clean beds, and I'll see they have them.
[plank:rounds] If you're ever laid up, I'll be by your bed every morning, I promise.
[plank:evenings] One good evening a week, that's all I'm asking for, and I'll make it happen.
[plank:kindness] Fewer grand plans and more small kindnesses, that's how I'd do it.
[plank:lean] I'll see enough grown that the lean season finds us ready.
[plank:newcrop] I want to try something new in the fields, and I'll own up if it fails.
[plank:table] If two of us are at odds, I'll sit them down before it comes to blows.
[plank:alone] Nobody new should eat alone here, and with me nobody will.
[plank:remember] Our dead deserve to be remembered on their days, and I'll remember them.
[plank:firstdays] Everyone who came later should hear how this place began, and I'll tell it.
[plank:pens] Clean pens, full troughs and no animal left in the cold, vote for that.
[plank:tame] There are animals out there that would do well with us, and I'll bring them in.
[plank:doubt] If your faith ever wears thin, whatever it is, come and talk to me.
[plank:grief] Nobody here should grieve alone, and I'll make sure nobody does.
[plank:road] I want travellers speaking well of us on the road, and I know how.
[plank:noguest] No guest of ours should leave hungry or sore, and with me none will.
[plank:stories] The young should hear the old stories before they're forgotten, and I'll tell them.
[plank:voice] Whoever came last week gets the same hearing as whoever came first, I promise you that.
[plank:ready] Before the next raid, every one of you will know your place, and I'll have checked it.
[plank:home] Everyone comes home from every fight, and I come home last, that's my promise.
[plank:fairshare] Everyone gets a fair share from the stores, and nobody gets favours, me least of all.
[plank:silver] I'll make our silver go further with every trader who comes to the gate.
[plank:clean] Clean beds and clean hands wherever our sick lie, that's what I'll keep.
[plank:rounds] Every morning I'll look in on whoever is ill or hurt, without fail.
[plank:evenings] Give me the seat and every week will have one evening worth looking forward to.
[plank:kindness] I won't promise grand plans, only small kindnesses, the kind you remember.
[plank:lean] Enough grown to carry us through the lean season, that's my promise to you.
[plank:newcrop] Let me try something new in the fields, and I'll tell you straight if it doesn't take.
[plank:table] Any two of us at odds will be sat down together before a fist is raised.
[plank:alone] Whoever comes to us next won't eat a single supper alone, I'll see to that.
[plank:remember] Every one of our dead will be remembered on their day, I promise you.
[plank:firstdays] The story of our first days belongs to everyone who came after, and I'll tell it.
[plank:pens] No animal of ours will be left out in the cold, and every trough will be full.
[plank:tame] I'll bring in a new animal or two from the wild, gently, the way it should be done.
[plank:doubt] Whatever you believe, if it wears thin, my door is open.
[plank:grief] When we lose someone, nobody grieves alone, I promise you.
[plank:road] Every traveller who passes will speak well of us further down the road.
[plank:noguest] Nobody who stops with us will leave hungry or with a grudge.
[plank:stories] Let me tell the young our old stories before nobody remembers them.
